Welcome home to Kits360, situated in the vibrant Kitsilano area. This condo features an open-concept floor plan with laminate wood flooring throughout, over-height ceilings, and floor-to-ceiling windows that allow natural light and fresh air to flood the home. The solarium provides a versatile space, while the large balcony offers a perfect place to relax and enjoy views of the city. The gourmet kitchen is thoughtfully designed with two-tone cabinetry, high-end appliances, quartz countertops, and an island bar—perfect for everyday living. Residents of Kits360 enjoy access to premium amenities such as a 24-hour concierge, fitness centre, and rooftop terrace with a lounge offering beautiful views of English Bay and Downtown.

Nestled in the heart of Vancouver, Kitsilano is in a coveted area within walking distance of gorgeous parks and amazing shopping, cafes and dining options. Stop for some delicious pastries and a coffee at Beaucoup Bakery and Cafe, and then head over to Vanier Park for a stroll along the seawall, or enjoy a day at Kitsilano Beach while enjoying the beautiful water views. Spend a day shopping along West 4th Ave or Granville St and then head down to Granville Island where you can browse the shops and pick up fresh groceries at the Public Market. For public transit, regular bus service stops along West 4th Avenue, Granville Street, and West Broadway for convenient access to the rest of Vancouver.
